P1.1.text: Niagen Bioscience, Formerly ChromaDex | The Leader in NAD+ Science – Niagen Bioscience | The Leading NAD+ Science and Research Company | There's a Better Way to Age

P1.2.text: Niagen Bioscience (formerly ChromaDex) is the premier leader in NAD+ research, clinical science, and ingredient innovation. Our ISO-accredited labs and peer-reviewed publications establish us as the gold standard for NAD+ supplementation and NAD+ precursors, delivering breakthrough cellular health solutions.

P1.3.text: Don't get old. Age Better®. Learn More

P1.4.text: New Clinical Study Explores Tru Niagen's Role in Long COVID Symptom Management

P1.6.text: Niagen Bioscience | The Leading NAD+ Science and Research Company | There's a Better Way to Age

P1.7.text: A leader in NAD+ science. Trusted by Kelly Slater.

P1.8.text: After decades in the water, Kelly knows what his body needs. Research-backed cellular support for healthy aging.

P1.9.text: We set the standard for NAD+ science

P1.10.text: we've built a foundation of scientific rigor—and for nearly a decade, we've led the field of NAD+ science. We're committed to following the science of NAD+ wherever it leads, and to letting new discoveries shape what comes next.

P1.11.text: The Science of NAD+ in Aging Goes Deeper Than Blood

P1.12.text: Blood and tissue NAD+ tell different parts of the same story. A new Niagen Bioscience white paper examines age-related NAD+ changes across the brain, skin, skeletal muscle, and liver—and the evidence for NAD+ precursors like Niagen® NR in whole-body restoration.

P1.13.text: There's a better way to age

P1.14.text: Uncovering the potential of NAD+ with precision science.​

P1.15.text: We exist to improve healthspan by restoring and optimizing NAD+ levels, empowering people to live healthier and more vibrant lives as they age.

P1.16.text: With over 25 years of innovation, Niagen Bioscience is the global leader in NAD+ research and technology. Our solutions are backed by world-class science, clinical research, and unmatched quality.

P1.17.text: Discover our industry leadership, Nobel Prize-winning research expertise, and market-leading position in the rapidly expanding NAD+ sector.

P1.19.text: Most dietary supplement ingredients have no independent quality standard. Niagen Bioscience spent over six years sponsoring the scientific work required to create one. The U.S. Pharmacopeia—the independent authority behind prescription drug standards—has now published an official monograph for NR Chloride. Niagen, our patented ingredient, is compliant with that standard. Tested, trusted, and recognized by global regulatory bodies. The gold standard in NAD+ science is here.

P1.20.text: We pioneer NAD+ innovation with groundbreaking research and uncompromising quality.

P1.21.text: Science-backed, research-driven Our discoveries are backed by clinical studies, proprietary patents, and world-class expertise.

P1.22.text: Partners with industry leaders We collaborate with top universities and researchers to advance NAD+ science and healthy aging.

P1.23.text: Unmatched quality and innovation Every ingredient we make is clinically researched and held to the highest standards, ensuring efficacy.

P1.24.text: Backed by 25+ years of research & innovation

P1.25.text: We've led the way in healthy aging science, pioneering discoveries in NAD+ with Niagen®.

P1.26.text: Discover our innovative, quality-tested, research-backed NAD-enhancement solutions.

P1.27.text: America's trusted NAD-boosting supplement. Our award-winning Tru Niagen products power your cells to thrive with clinically proven daily support.

P1.28.text: For health enthusiasts seeking advanced treatments, Niagen Plus delivers pharmaceutical-grade, fast-acting NAD+ enhancement therapies.

P1.29.text: "In the supplement industry, where claims often outpace evidence, scientific rigor is paramount. This is why I'm particularly impressed by the work being done at Niagen Bioscience."

P1.30.text: Roger Kornberg, Ph.D., Niagen Bioscience Scientific Advisory Board Chairman

P1.31.text: Nobel Prize Winner in Chemistry (2006) and Winzer Professor in Medicine at Stanford University

P1.32.text: "Disturbances in NAD coenzymes can leave tissues unable to repair themselves, generate energy, and perform their normal homeostatic functions. In many conditions of metabolic stress, the genes that convert NR to NAD are up-regulated, which provides unique value over all other NAD precursors."
